summary: Enterprise Financial Services Corp filed a prospectus supplement for a $175M offering of 6.25% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036. The notes pay fixed 6.25% for five years, then float at Three-Month Term SOFR plus 232bps. Proceeds to the issuer, before expenses, are $172.8125M. The notes are unsecured, subordinated, and not listed on any exchange. There is no redemption or conversion into equity, no identified target or acquirer. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation.
